risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively quantitative and transparent, but relies heavily on complex non-GAAP adjustments and lengthy technical explanations. Liquidity risk is notable because available liquidity was $90 million below debt obligations due within 12 months, with continued access dependent on member rollovers and dealer commercial paper markets.
